reviews.title: The App That Helps Me Exercise Every Day
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the 7 Minute Workout app and I’m really enjoying it. What I love the most is how easy it makes exercising, even on busy days.

The workouts are short (only 7 minutes), but they are surprisingly effective. The app guides you through different exercises with clear instructions and a timer, so you don’t have to think about what to do next. You just follow along.

It’s perfect for people who want to stay active but don’t have a lot of time. I can do it at home, without equipment, and still feel like I did a good workout.

Another thing I like is that it helps me stay consistent. When a workout is only 7 minutes, it’s much easier to say “yes” to exercising every day.

reviews.title: Great app, better with upgrade
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app off and on for years, pretty much since that NYT article came out about the seven minute workout. I did the free version for many years before deciding to so the $25 annual upgrade, and I wishes I’d have done it sooner because I think I would have kept doing it more often with the nice variety of similar but different exercises. I’ve done the paid version a couple years now but even without it, I highly recommend it. 

I like how it keeps track of all workouts and shows the streak tracker. While you can adapt the amount of time on workouts, I haven’t used that but it’s a great feature. 

At this point, the only thing that would make me like it even more is more workout versions with higher level versions of the exercise. Maybe like Body Boss whose book I used for several years, too, when I wanted something more sophisticated and intense. But they don’t have an app to count down and tell you the next exercises which I like to have while listening to a podcast.

reviews.title: 200+ workouts in, still love this app
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for many years. Sometimes I use it a lot, sometimes not at all for months. In total I’ve finished over 200 workouts with it, and I’d say it’s the perfect blend of off the shelf useful and customizable. You could download it and start your first workout in 30 seconds. Or you can create your own workout entirely - the exercises, work / rest periods, and # of sets, and have the app read out each exercise name for you. I started with the traditional 7 minutes but usually do more than twice that now (50-60 seconds work, 10-20 secs rest). I’ve made my own workouts and used their original workout in particular a lot of times. This app is great if you need a quick workout, a custom guided interval workout, or just want something you can follow without having to think about it. Never had any bugs or issues. Highly recommend.
